modals.rulesIntro: Guess the randomly selected secret word from the available word pool:
rulesList: Every word contains between 7 and 10 letters.
You have a maximum of 7 mistakes to discover it.
Score is calculated as: Discovered letters × (7 - Mistakes made).
Repeated letters or invalid entries do not penalize or reduce score.
Words already played are not repeated during the active session.

tutorial.title: How to play?
tutorial.step1: A random word of 7 to 10 letters is chosen.
tutorial.step2: Type a letter in the text field and press CHECK.
tutorial.step3: If the letter is in the word, it is revealed in its position.
tutorial.step4: If not, it counts as a mistake. You have a maximum of 7 mistakes.
tutorial.step5: The more letters you guess and the fewer mistakes you make, the higher your score.
